summary: Great Southern Bancorp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to declare a $0.43 per common share quarterly dividend, payable July 14, 2026, to holders of record June 29, 2026. This is a routine capital return action, the 146th consecutive quarterly dividend. No terms such as premium, implied value, or board recommendation apply, and no structural or regulatory complexities are present. The filing is an ordinary dividend declaration, not a special-situation event such as a capital return special distribution or tender offer. Watch for ongoing dividend stability; no risk-arb angle exists.
